svg.title: Serial and parallel rig queries on the same 50 anchors
svg.desc: Empirical CDFs of all 100 warm decode-plus-backend query times per variant (50 anchors in two fresh processes each, after three warm-up queries) for serial and per-camera parallel execution on LaMAria R_03_easy two-SLAM-camera and RGB queries, on the SLAM and RGB maps. Source: benchmarks/lamaria_r03_parallel_query.json sha256 6ac4dae48dfb3bd60456017cafc0e5fe593eaa2a81aee63a3439b41d5c7aba39.
svg.text: Serial and parallel rig queries on the same 50 anchors
Dashed: serial reference. Solid: parallel candidate. Compare maps within one query type; RGB queries have one camera.
Warm decode + backend query time (s), n=100
RGB map · serial: median 1.441 s · p90 1.546 s · accepted 100/100
RGB map · parallel: median 1.134 s · p90 1.290 s · accepted 100/100
SLAM map · serial: median 1.486 s · p90 1.617 s · accepted 100/100
SLAM map · parallel: median 1.185 s · p90 1.309 s · accepted 100/100
RGB: 1 × 1024×768 image, 20 matches (one camera, serial in both)
Warm decode + backend query time (s), n=100
RGB map · serial: median 0.752 s · p90 0.848 s · accepted 100/100
RGB map · candidate, ran serial: median 0.783 s · p90 0.882 s · accepted 100/100
SLAM map · serial: median 0.828 s · p90 0.931 s · accepted 98/100
SLAM map · candidate, ran serial: median 0.828 s · p90 0.882 s · accepted 98/100
LaMAria R_03_easy (Gen 1) · 100 warm timed rows per variant = the same 50 anchors in two fresh processes each (A/B/B/A), after three warm-up queries.
Time = decode/rectification + backend through CUDA completion; harness checks and MPS diagnostics ran outside the timer, so it is not the serial table's metric.
One CUDA GPU, four CPU threads. Accepted counts and poses matched serial in every row. No division by camera count; other hardware will differ.
